task_completion.description: The UGENE graphical interface is launched and visible.

task_completion.description: A local BLAST database is created using the environmental_swabs.fasta file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'FormatDB' or 'Build BLAST Database' dialog in UGENE showing the input file 'environmental_swabs.fasta' and the output name 'swabs_db' in the specified directory.

task_completion.description: A local BLAST search is performed using mcr_1_reference.fasta against the created swabs_db.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Search with BLAST' dialog in UGENE with 'mcr_1_reference.fasta' as the query and 'swabs_db' selected as the local database.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' or 'Save as' dialog in UGENE showing the file path '~/UGENE_Data/outbreak/results/mcr1_hits.gff' and the GFF format selected.

task_completion.description: A text report is created identifying Hospital_Swab_A as the contaminated swab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or UGENE document viewer showing 'surveillance_report.txt' with text explicitly naming 'Hospital_Swab_A' (or Hospital_Swab_A_Isolate) as the source of the mcr-1 gene.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI for BLAST operations rather than the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interactions with UGENE menus and dialog boxes; no terminal windows showing 'makeblastdb' or 'blastn' commands being executed.

integrity.description: The BLAST results shown in the GUI correspond to the actual sequence alignment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Alignment' or 'Search Results' pane shows a high-identity hit between the reference and a sequence labeled 'Hospital_Swab_A_Isolate'.

integrity.description: The GFF file was generated via UGENE export, not manually typed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Export' workflow is visible in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The mcr-1 gene is synthetically placed within 'Hospital_Swab_A_Isolate'. The BLAST database must be named 'swabs_db' and located in '~/UGENE_Data/outbreak/blast_db/'. The final report must identify Hospital_Swab_A as the contaminated sample. Command-line BLAST execution is strictly forbidden for this task.
